hooks.prompt: Check ONLY if tool_input.file_path is under ~/my-project/docs/ and ends in .md — otherwise respond ok:true immediately with no further analysis. If it is a docs .md file: compare tool_input.new_string/content against the rest of the file and the edit's apparent purpose. Flag (ok:false) ONLY if the added text makes a concrete technical/architectural claim (e.g. naming something a 'pillar', 'governor', 'branding', asserting a component's purpose or design beyond plain fact) that is NOT: (a) a direct quote or clear paraphrase of something the operator (Stephen) said in the conversation, or (b) directly backed by a command/file citation in the same edit. Do not flag operator-attributed intent/metaphor sections that are already labeled as such (e.g. '[INF]', 'operator's own words', family-metaphor sections). Do not flag plain factual corrections, status updates, or citations of real command output. Input: $ARGUMENTS
